description: Blastproof -> A lightweight Fabric mod to cancel explosion block-damage and fire-creation with in-game commands and JSON config.

mods.name: Blastproof
mods.description: Control block damage, fire creation, and mob effects caused by explosions.

mods.name: Blastproof
mods.description: Control block damage, fire creation, and mob effects caused by explosions.

releases.notes:
* Add per-source mob explosion immunity with /blastproof disableMobDamage
* Keep player and non-mob explosion behavior unchanged
* Classify beds and respawn anchors independently from other

Upgrading from 0.2.x: other no longer overrides bed or respawn_anchor; configure those explicit keys instead.
